scope: Maintained Python implementation; test oracles are not mutation targets
invalid_reason: Cosmic Ray 8.7.0 ExceptionReplacer cannot construct two dotted-exception mutations; neither is counted as a kill.
equivalence_policy: Individual proofs and declared-profile assumptions are recorded in equivalent-mutations.json. Equivalents are not relabeled as kills.
limitations: A finite mutation operator set is not a correctness proof.
Equivalence assumptions are scoped to documented entry points, CPython 3.12 and the pinned public-only dependency profile.
No Rust or concentrating-PDE validation is implied.
